name: autoswe-live-e2e
purpose: A corpus of live test cases: each one is an issue to create in a real GitHub or Azure DevOps project, the comments to post on it, and the process autoSWE must follow in response.
_note: There is nothing to execute here - no scripts, no cron files, no queue access. An agent reads these files, drives real issues through the provider API, and reports what diverges.

driver.who: openclaw (or any agent that can call the provider API)
does: creates its own recurring wake-up schedule for the duration of the run (10-15 minutes)
creates one issue per case, using the case file's exact title and body
on each wake-up, advances every unfinished case by one step - posting the next comment only once the previous step's expected label has appeared
verifies what autoSWE actually did, against the case file and the docs it cites
files one issue per finding in the autoSWE repo
deletes its own schedule when the pass is done
must_not: alter the [E2E-NN] prefix in an issue title - it is the only thing that identifies which case an issue belongs to
post a command while a running label (planning/fixing/syncing/reviewing/shipping) is on the issue
advance a case on a timer instead of on an observed label
re-drive issues from a previous pass

files.tests/e2e/README.md: The runbook: the loop, start to finish
files.tests/e2e/SETUP.md: What the test project must contain, and the config a run assumes
files.tests/e2e/MATRIX.md: Permutations - backend x phase split x provider - and case groups
files.tests/e2e/VERIFY.md: How to check a step: the evidence, and what each observation proves
files.tests/e2e/REPORTING.md: How to write up a finding, with the template
files.tests/e2e/cases/: One file per case; cases/README.md indexes them

cases.covers: question, resumed by a plain reply
question, resumed by a slash command
sync conflict resolved by the agent
review needs changes, pr refused, automatic re-review
review blocked on a critical finding
failure, retry replay, attempt guard, session provenance
crash -> error, and the wall-clock guard

upstream_docs._note: The cases test the behaviour these describe. A finding is only real if it contradicts one of them.
